hypothesis: Adding a translation-invariant work-function spread correction alpha*(max(wf_norm)-min(wf_norm)) to the verified 5-violation canonical potential can improve the global circle metric while providing a materially different potential family for a later full taxi gate.
rationale: All five exact taxi failures of the pinned seed occur on depth-0 transitions with d_min=0 and ext=2, where the canonical potential rises by only 1. Coefficient mutations around the canonical family produced a 348,550-violation regression, and complete-circle-zero selection produced 54-violation regressions. A spread term changes the representation using a shift-invariant statistic of the full work function rather than changing pairwise-distance coefficients or selecting on fixed failing edges.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether a simple nonlinear, translation-invariant correction has any global signal on the complete circle instance. A meaningful circle improvement justifies implementing the same candidate class for the exact taxi gate; no circle improvement closes this correction family without spending taxi-scale compute.
method: Load the locked upstream source, pinned circle_k4_m6 metric, and the independently reproduced SEED_VECTORS[0] coefficients. Compute the canonical potential and the work-function spread at every one of the 1,001 circle nodes. Evaluate the exact circle inequality count for alpha in {-8,-4,-2,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,2,4,8}. Use the circle result only as a global screen; do not inspect or optimize against individual taxi failure edges. If a materially lower circle count appears, implement the identical correction through the upstream Potential interface and exact-score at most two taxi candidates with the eight-worker streaming evaluator, independently reproducing any result below 3.
metric: screening: exact complete circle_k4_m6 violations_k; primary follow-up only if screening signal appears: exact full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k
metric_relation_to_true_objective: Circle screening is a complete-instance proxy and cannot establish target progress. Only an exact full taxi result below 3 reaches the frozen finite target; a finite result remains incomplete evidence for the full conjecture.

configuration.follow_up_gate: at most two exact taxi candidates only if global circle signal appears

compute_budget.memory_intent: retain node potentials only; no taxi cache

kill_condition: Stop after the complete 1,001-node circle screen, at 180 seconds, or at a precise runtime failure. Do not promote a candidate from circle movement alone and do not run taxi follow-up if every tested alpha is non-improving.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: circle signal is required before any taxi follow-up; strict target progress only if a full taxi result scores below 3

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: new correction must first beat the canonical seed on the complete circle proxy and then survive the exact taxi gate

interpretation: Pending execution; no result is interpreted before the preregistered complete-circle screen runs.
what_was_learned: Pending execution; the test asks whether a shift-invariant nonlinear work-function statistic provides global signal absent from coefficient-only mutations.
recommended_next_action: After execution, run the exact taxi follow-up only if a tested alpha materially improves the complete circle score; otherwise close this correction family.
repetition_justification: This changes the potential representation by adding a nonlinear shift-invariant work-function statistic. It is not a coefficient perturbation, fixed-edge proxy, circle-zero shortlist, or worker-count variation.
